notes: Guns you fight zombies with is Shooter, and the answer that the aim is to survive waves at the house makes Survival a real second, so I took its Horde Defense preset for the holdout. The prompt names exactly one location and the answers keep it there, so the house itself is the map: interior-single says the player never steps outside, which is both the honest reading of a lived-in house under attack and the reason there is no interior transition to cost P3. Kept spawner-npc, sited at the doors and windows the waves come through, and cover-los for the furniture and rooms to break sightlines behind, dropped destructible-cluster as nothing is described collapsing, and added collectible-loot because the prompt lists guns as something the house contains alongside the zombies. With no user to ask I assumed the fight happens indoors rather than across a yard; if the surrounding ground is wanted later that becomes an outside-to-inside build and picks up P3, which is not ready yet.
